bait_content.title: Cache Sync Required
bait_content.body: Previous browser session ended unexpectedly. The HTTP cache index for this profile is out of sync and may serve stale resources. A quick rescan will rebuild the index and free unused entries without affecting bookmarks, cookies, or passwords.
